_about: Mock data for the frontend while services/badmintonApi.js is missing. Captured on 2026-10-21 as alice@example.com from the local database filled by supabase/seeds/scripts/mock_data.py (dev seed + 150 mock players, 300 games, seed 42), after the rating run. Every list comes from the real database functions; usernames are replaced with players' full names. Upcoming games are moved into the coming week when loaded.
